# CPU policy agent

`driver.py` is the collected JSON entry point: it reads one UTF-8 JSON request
from standard input, validates the whole-request envelope, replays every job and
writes one JSON response to standard output.  Kernel attachment, service
deployment and packet capture stay outside this project.

## Modules

* `syntax.py` - policy tokenizer, recursive-descent parser and the declared
  policy bounds (predicate depth, path length, complex-rule, non-match atom and
  per-string occurrence limits).  Parsing never consults the service registry,
  so a syntactically valid string is counted for the whole-request atom and
  path-service totals even when it names an unregistered service.
* `compiler/compiler.py` - serial policy reduction.  It registry-checks every
  path and hands the rules to the state exporter, raising `CompileError` for an
  unregistered name or an image above the exported row bound.
* `ebpf/create_dfa.py` - the CPU state exporter.  It builds the trie of every
  `match` word plus one dead node, the deterministic border machines of the
  `startswith`/`endswith`/`contains` atoms, takes their reachable product,
